name: fresh-eyes
description: Get fresh eyes on what you just built. A /fresh-eyes:review command distills your session's goal into a task brief (what + why, never how), then delegates to a read-only reviewer subagent that checks your diff against it in its own clean context — no confirmation bias from the build chat — then you fix the findings in the session that still knows every decision. Pass --blind for a pure code-only review.
